question: _______ was the first person who discovered cells.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Robert Hooke**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **In 1665, a British scientist named Robert Hooke coined the term "cell" to describe these minuscule units of life.**
 
• Hooke was one of the first scientists to use a microscope to study live organisms.
 
• Despite the fact that Hooke's microscopes were not very powerful at the time, he was nonetheless able to make a sign
